The '''Customs Building''' was a [[Planet/Legends|planetary]] location. The [[Unidentified governor (SCS-19 Sentinel)|local governor]] passed close to the Customs Building while piloting his [[Tagge Company/Legends|TaggeCo.]] [[SCS-19 Sentinel/Legends|SCS-19 Sentinel]]. The protestors who opposed him had planted [[vibro-mine]]s in the alleyway near to it.
